region_scene_page.compact: A vocal-group oldies road where harmony, syllables, bass voices, and lead-voice drama carry the whole record.
region_scene_page.standard: Doo-wop grew through Black and Italian American urban vocal groups, neighborhood singing, R&B labels, and pop radio. Some records are rough street-corner performances, while others, like The Platters, polish the language into elegant crossover ballads. The arrangement is the signature: the backing voices do not just decorate the lead, they create rhythm, harmony, atmosphere, and emotional commentary.
